# Third-party assets

Every third-party asset in this project, with its licence (NFR_Licensing).

| Asset | Folder | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fredoka font | `Fonts/Fredoka/` | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/fredoka | SIL Open Font License 1.1. See `OFL.txt`. |
| Interface Sounds (Kenney): tap, whoosh, hop, steps, golden, blink, correct, try again, wiggle, sparkle, tick, count, go, locked | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/interface-sounds | CC0 |
| Win Jingle (fupi): reward, purchase | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/win-jingle | CC0 |
| Cute Mission Complete (fupi): round end | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/cute-mission-complete | CC0 |
| Correct Bell (fupi): star | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/correct-bell | CC0 |
| Positive Sound (ezduzziteh): cheer | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/positive-sound | CC0 |
| 3 Pop Sounds (wubitog): caption pops | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/3-pop-sounds | CC0 |
| 40 CC0 Water, Splash and Slime SFX (rubberduck): catch, shiver | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/40-cc0-water-splash-slime-sfx | CC0 |
| 100 CC0 SFX (rubberduck): plip, wipe | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/100-cc0-sfx | CC0 |
| Purchasing Sound Effect (fupi): coins landing in the purse | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/purchasing-sound-effect | CC0 |
| Bubble Sound Effects (bmaczero): drop fall | `_Project/Audio/` | https://opengameart.org/content/bubble-sound-effects | CC0 |

The sounds are trimmed, levelled and renamed by `Tools/SoundFetch/fetch_sounds.py`, which
downloads them from the pages above. CC0 needs no credit; they are listed so they can be traced.

Everything else is original and made for this project:

- **Art:** characters, avatar parts, props, rooms, icons and seek-and-find pictures are SVG,
  generated by `Tools/ArtGen/generate_art.py` and `Tools/ArtGen/avatar_parts.py`, in the style
  of the team's first 2D PoC.
